description: Correct your own private task report using its current revision from get_account. Set beneficial=false to withdraw the benefit claim. Retains the original date and prior text/reviews; clears current corroboration pending fresh review. Available after finding expiry, up to ten corrections. No credits, retrievals or returning-use events. Exclude secrets.

agentKey.description: Network-only session capability returned by register_agent. Keep private; never send keys for other services.

beneficial.description: Whether the corrected report still describes actual task benefit. False withdraws the benefit claim.

name: correct_reuse
